other_conditions: Family must have a permanent residence certificate (Ration Card, Aadhaar Card, Voter ID Card, Electricity bill or Telephone bill)

benefits_summary: Cash assistance of up to ₹15,000 per girl is provided in six installments linked to birth, vaccination, and educational milestones.
documents_required: Permanent residence certificate (Ration Card, Aadhaar Card, Voter ID Card, Electricity bill or Telephone bill)
